messages:
Hannah T: Heads up team, scheduling rollout of feature flag `edge-optimizer-v2` with model v3.2 during 02:00 UTC change window. Regional single-step ramps: EU->NA->APAC. Steps: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Soak: EU 10m, NA 25m, APAC 20m. Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/edge-optimizer-2026

Mason L: Will we keep v2 pinned for APAC until 20%? last time APAC regressed when unpinned too early.

Hannah T: Yes, plan is to pin v2 in APAC until it hits 20%. For EU/NA we'll unpin after their 20% soak if healthy.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Hannah T at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Canary eu-west-1 at 2%. Health checks posted here.

QA: Telemetry gates: request_error_rate (5m), p95_latency (5m), 99th_token_latency (10m). Auto-fallback: if error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > baseline + 150ms for 2 consecutive windows, set region pct to 0 and re-pin to v2.

ops-bot: Alerting configured: post to #eng-releases and page oncall for auto-fallback. CLI exclusion: use `--exclude-cohorts internal_* --exclude canary_*`.

Mason L: CLI snippets for ops:
```
# start EU at 2%
/ff toggle edge-optimizer-v2 --region eu --pct 2 --exclude-cohorts internal_* --exclude-cohorts canary_*
# bump to 20% after healthy
/ff toggle edge-optimizer-v2 --region eu --pct 20
# emergency disable and pin v2
/ff toggle edge-optimizer-v2 --pct 0 --pin v2 --reason "auto-rollback or manual"
```

Hannah T: Pacing tweak accepted: EU 10m, NA 25m, APAC 20m. Manual rollback window 02:10-03:00 UTC. Release notes draft for support: "edge-optimizer-v2 (v3.2) phased regional rollout to improve p95 latency; pinned fallback to v2 for APAC until 20% stable."

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary EU at 2%. Will report 5m/10m checks.

(End of thread)
